newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samlip to file for court receivership.
newsitem.headline: Samlip to file for court receivership.

text.p: South Korea's leading confectionery maker Samlip General Foods Co said it planned to file for court receivership on Thursday because of financial problems.
A Samlip statement filed with the Korea Stock Exchange said the financial problems had resulted from "excessive investment and its payment guarantees on debts owed by its affiliates".
Trading in Samlip shares was suspended from Thursday morning when the exchange cited rumours.
The statement put Samlip's total debt at 191.01 billion won at the end of calendar 1996, more than six times its equity capital of 30.52 billion.
Samlip ran a net loss of 3.52 billion won in calendar 1996, compared with the previous year's loss of 11.27 billion.
